name: Runaway 2: The Dream of the Turtle

locations.note: Brian and Gina's Hawaiian holiday goes wrong when Brian pushes Gina out of the plane with the only parachute and crash-lands in the jungle.
Brian and Joshua reach Professor Simon's walled compound, where the assassin Tarantula attacks.
The Maya ruins of Palenque, where a cache of Trantonite was hidden, are one stop in the hunt for the mineral.
